source_object: AP Grange issuer call notice, trustee notice, or paying-agent redemption statement
minimum_fields: Affected CUSIP/tranche, legal issuer, call or redemption date, principal/par amount, call price, paying agent, gross proceeds, and payment date
promotion_join: Join the Q2 2026 $673M issuer gain and June 30 disappearance to G2964#-AA-7 or G2964#-AB-5 and a dated payment event

source_object: Athene custodian statement, trade confirmation, cash ledger, or statutory lot-level call allocation
minimum_fields: Athene legal holder, exact identifier, lot/par amount, settlement date, proceeds, receivable or bank account, fees, and realized gain/loss
promotion_join: Reconcile Athene's Schedule D Tranche A holding and Schedule BA Tranche B event rows to an Athene-specific remittance or cash receipt

source_object: Athene Schedule D/BA post-call population and Part 4/5 continuation
minimum_fields: Identifier-level beginning and ending holdings, acquisition/disposal nature, consideration, income, adjusted carrying value, and counterparty
promotion_join: Tie the statutory lot chronology and consideration to the call notice without treating a column amount as settled cash

source_object: Apollo credit-strategy redemption or AP Grange prepayment allocation schedule
minimum_fields: Fund or wrapper, tranche/CUSIP, investor or legal entity, redemption amount, cash date, receiving account, and allocation between Athene and other holders
promotion_join: Reconcile Apollo's approximately $5.0B credit-strategy redemption observation to the specific AP Grange tranche and Athene/Apollo entity, without promoting fund flow to parent cash

source_object: Athene asset-level liability-cost, tax, and common-owner waterfall schedule
minimum_fields: Asset-level funding source, liability or capital charge, tax, fees, residual legal-entity cash, upstream distribution, senior claims, and common-owner allocation
promotion_join: Calculate a dated after-cost return and only then test whether any residual reached Apollo common owners
